items.title: "the blob" has 720 sexes, solves mazes without a brain, and can merge seamlessly with fellow blobs
items.dek: A specimen of the blob (or maybe an indeterminant number given its fluid like properties) is currently in display at a zoo in Paris. It is a type of slime mould
items.body: A specimen of the blob (or maybe an indeterminant number given its fluid like properties) is currently in display at a zoo in Paris. It is a type of slime mould, a form of life that seemingly exists for the sole purpose of confusing biologists. submitted by /u/alldagoodnamesaregon [link] [comments]
